name: What types of renovations offer the best return on investment for rental properties?

mainEntity.name: What types of renovations offer the best return on investment for rental properties?

acceptedAnswer.text: Renovations that enhance functionality, curb appeal, and broad tenant appeal typically offer the best ROI. Kitchen and bathroom updates, adding a fresh coat of paint, improving landscaping, and upgrading energy-efficient appliances are often good choices. These improvements can increase rental income, attract higher-quality tenants, and reduce vacancy periods. Focusing on durable, low-maintenance materials is also key to minimizing ongoing costs and maximizing long-term returns.
acceptedAnswer.description: Kitchen and bathroom updates, fresh paint, landscaping improvements, and energy-efficient appliance upgrades generally offer the best return on investment for rental properties.
